parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian барс (bars), From a Turkic language, ultimately from Proto-Turkic *bars, also related to Proto-Mongolic *bars. See Turkish pars, Mongolian бар (bar), Dongxiang basi.

parole.significato: kulak (free farmer within the Communist bloc who opposed collectivization)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian кула́к (kulák, “fist”), probably of Turkic origin.
